description: This file defines an interface for filtering or initializing server requests within the Laminas Diactoros library. It specifies a contract for implementing classes to modify or wrap incoming server requests, often for purposes like injecting headers or rewriting URIs based on headers such as X-Forwarded-*, Forwarded, etc.

classes.name: FilterServerRequestInterface
classes.description: An interface to filter or initialize server requests, allowing implementations to modify incoming server request objects.

methods.name: __invoke
methods.description: Determines if a request needs further modification and returns a new instance reflecting those modifications if necessary.
